Portrait setting: a narrow back alley in Kamino Ward at night. Behind the character it runs between worn concrete and tile-clad buildings: drainpipes, air-conditioning units, stacked plastic crates, a steel back door under a bare bulb; tangled power lines cross the strip of sky. A drink vending machine stands against the wall at the character's side. Puddles on cracked asphalt. No other people. No readable signs or text.

Portrait lighting — Key: a sodium streetlamp at the alley mouth, warm orange-yellow, from one side and slightly behind the camera. Fill: the vending machine's cool white glow, from the side opposite the streetlamp. Bounce: broken reflections off wet asphalt and puddles. Practical: the vending machine, the bare bulb over the back door, a few lit windows high above.
